_comment: Repositories featured in the website's Projects atlas. Read by js/modules/thoughts.js.
`group` is the track a repo is listed under. Tracks appear in the order they first occur, and repos in file order within their track, so keep each track's entries together.

An entry with `expand` (a path to a data file) is a placeholder: it keeps that track in this position, and its tiles come from the file. `Claude Code skills` expands from data/claude-skills.json, which scripts/fetch-skills.js writes from the skills repo, so do not list skills here.
`name` and `owner` are optional overrides; by default both are read from the repo URL.
`image` is optional: leave it empty and the detail panel shows a title card instead.
Prefer a local file in assets/projects/ (WebP, about 1200px wide, under 250 KB) over a remote URL: a raw screenshot or GIF from a README can weigh several megabytes.

repos.description: Automated mapping of pan-Arctic abrupt thaw landscapes using deep learning and remote sensing imagery.
Arctic Retrogressive Thaw Slumps Data Set
An interactive geospatial labeling tool for remote sensing imagery, built on the Segment Anything Model (SAM).

Deep learning pipelines for monthly environmental time series in three domains: emulating the Terrestrial Ecosystem Model's carbon fluxes across the circumpolar Arctic, predicting river discharge and wildfire in the Amazon basin, and emulating the RangeSTAR carbon-flux model in rangelands. A shared transformer trained on all three tests whether pooling data helps the data-scarce domains. A Woodwell collaboration.

An open-source decision tool for one question: where should I live? It scores every area of a city by your own weights and hard limits, lights up the best areas on a map, and explains every score one layer at a time. It starts with London and is in its foundations phase.

This site, and the single-source-of-truth pipeline behind it. One data layer renders the website and both PDF CVs, then tailors a one-pager and cover letter to a job posting — where every generated sentence must cite the fact it came from, or the build fails. No number on the CV is typed twice.
A frosted-glass desktop widget (Tauri v2 + Rust) showing live Claude Code usage — session and weekly quota with reset countdowns.
My flight log, drawn on an interactive globe.
A daily email of Octopus Agile energy prices, sent by GitHub Actions.
LLM-enhanced automatic bookkeeping and a personal finance dashboard.
